player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Player {player_id} muNim.
Lakiro rakowo ni kuchera chombo chimwe chete chisiri kuchera.
Pa kila turn, chagua nhambwe imwe chete na ubviswe chombo chimwe kana kuti zhinji kwayo.
Tumia fomati '[pile quantity]', apo nhambwe ndiyo inyika yenhambwe na quantity ndiyo idadi ya chombo chinobviswa.
Saka kwa mfano, '[0 3]' inabvisa chombo 3 kubva kwenhambwe 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hapana chimiro chakanaka chekufambisa chakawanikwa. Shandisa '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Kusaziva kwako hakusiwi. Kolomnde {col} iri kunze kwenhambwe.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Hauwezi kubvisa {quantity} kubva kwenhambwe {pile_index} (kune {pile_count} riri kuwiririka).

observation.removed_from_piles: Mchezaji {player_id} akacheza [{pile_index} {quantity}], akabvisa {quantity} zvinhu kubva kwa murwi {pile_index}.
